author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Claude Connectors step by step. In this beginner-friendly tutorial, you'll learn how to connect Claude AI to Gmail and other popular services so Claude can access your data and help you get work done faster.

You'll see how to:
- Connect Claude to Gmail
- Review and prioritize emails with AI
- Draft email responses directly from Claude
- Understand Claude's permission settings
- Connect Claude to thousands of additional apps using Zapier MCP
- Send emails and automate actions across connected apps

By the end of this tutorial, you'll know how to extend Claude beyond chat and turn it into a powerful assistant that can work with your favorite tools and services.
